what: Leave one session out. Train on the other sessions' stops (same phone model = same_model; a different handset of the same phone = cross_handset), test every stop of the held-out session. Visit answer = mean kNN probability over its 2 s windows, among places on the true floor.

rules.R0: pressure only: 0.40 hPa from the median of the last 6 readings, reference emptied after a 15-min gap, no pressure = floor kept
rules.d: R0 while pressure is present and continuous; magnetic floor vote (k 15, 2 s xyz windows, same phone model, other sessions) at stops without pressure and the first 3 stops after a gap; 2 votes with p >= 0.7 in a row switch; barometer ignored for ['SM-S9280']
rules.app_default: what the app does by default: d for phones with a barometer, R0 for ['SM-A556E', 'SM-A566B', 'SM-S9280'] (WALKSENSE_FLOOR_VOTE_NO_BARO=1 gives them d)

train_exclude.25night a56: Chris's a56 on the 25-Nov night: magnetometer hard-iron offset (about 85 uT off, drifting after 22:59); team decision option B, PROCESS-LOG 77 (clean-data/2026-11-25-night/field_check.csv)

floor_rule.floor_tracking: iPhone stops under the app default (d); floor_tracking_by_rule has every phone, R0, d (pre-registered, every phone) and app_default, stops and walks; every unit starts on its true first floor
